When you\'re done with Respiro, turn USB and network debugging off again in Settings › Developer options.
An app turned back on returns as it came from the factory; the Play Store updates it again.

Debugging is off. Go to Settings › Device Preferences › About, press OK on Build seven times, then in Developer options turn on USB debugging (and Network debugging if your TV has it). Then try again.
Android didn\'t allow Respiro in time. Try again and choose Always allow when asked. If no question appears, restart the TV: a question left pending earlier can hide new ones.
The connection to the TV dropped while Respiro was working. What it switched off so far is listed under See what\'s off; open Respiro again to finish.
